title: Machine part of an issue report
description: issues/<id>/library/report.json, written by the issue's agent right before `kanban report`, whole each time. Only these keys. pr is required once a PR is open; that is checked by `andon issue ready`, not by this schema.

commit.description: HEAD when the report was written. Required for an issue with a repository (andon issue report writes it and andon issue ready checks it); absent for an issue without one.

pr.description: URL of the issue's pull request; owner and repo are printable ASCII without /. The gate reads only this.

review_request.description: Present only when asking for a review. The dispatcher starts the reviewer.

limit.description: review_rounds of the issue. The dispatcher starts a reviewer only when round <= limit.

commit.description: The commit to review. Must be the PR head.

previous.description: The commit of the previous round; only previous..commit is reviewed again. null on the first round.

extra.description: true for a round beyond the limit; the Chief of Staff decides whether to start it.

estimate.description: The agent's own estimate when it differs from the issue's estimate (issue.yaml, written by the Chief of Staff). It never changes the issue's estimate; the dispatcher keeps comparing with that one. andon issue report carries it over from the previous report.json when --data has none.

reason.description: Why the agent sees it differently, in one line.

waived.description: Findings left unfixed, with the reason.

acceptance.description: Results against the acceptance criteria of the Chief Engineer's document, when there are any.

result.description: fail makes the gate answer fix; manual raises the tier by one.

evidence.description: The test command and the path of its output (including the trace of a use case run). Staged output and tests that mock the seam under test are not evidence.

risk.description: The agent's own statement of whether the change itself cannot be undone (a data migration, a delete, a promise to the outside). It only raises the gate's tier: one_way true makes it C; false or absent never lowers it.

one_way.description: true when the change cannot be undone by a revert. The gate reads only this.

impact.description: What the change reaches, for people. The gate does not read it.

to.description: person, chief-of-staff, or issue (to be cut into a next issue).

observation.description: Only for an observation issue (ADR-0011): the result of checking a value hypothesis of the Chief Engineer's document against the signals. Nothing in the line acts on it; the Chief of Staff tells the owner in one line.

hypothesis.description: The value hypothesis that was checked, in one line.

result.description: hit: it held; miss: it did not; unknown: the signals do not tell.

evidence.description: What was read to decide: signal keys, URLs or paths.

remember.description: Machine copy of the report's Remember section.

agents_md.description: Machine copy of the report's For AGENTS.md lines.

sha.description: A full git commit id: 40 lowercase hex digits.
